name: Yaezakura Miru
source:
Hobbies: Reading fishing magazines
Likes: Drinking, smoking, [url=https://washokufood.blogspot.fi/2008/04/tsumami-snack.html]tsumami[/url]
Dislikes: Alcohol & smoking prohibition, talking about her age, milk (boobs don't grow at all from drinking it!!)

[url=/c55449]Shinobu's[/url] class teacher who is very easy to talk to and has a friendly personality, which is why she's popular with her students. A very heavy drinker and smoker whose mood gets even worse when she needs her fix of nicotine, and hates talking about both marriage and her age. Miru is [url=/c53405]Nazuna's[/url] former classmate and the two remain close friends even after graduation; in fact, Nazuna still keeps taking care of Miru. Instead of going to her own house, she crashes into Shinobu's house almost every day.
